firmwares.name: esp32
firmwares.description: ESP32 classic with more than 4 MB flash, every revision: WiFi + Ethernet, every feature; PSRAM used on revision 3 and up.

firmwares.name: esp32-lite
firmwares.description: ESP32 classic with 4 MB flash, every revision: WiFi + Ethernet, the 4 MB tier (no SD card); PSRAM used on revision 3 and up.

firmwares.name: esp32-ethonly
firmwares.description: ESP32 classic, every revision: Ethernet only (WiFi compiled out, so every feature fits 4 MB and more RAM stays free). Per-board pins/PHY from deviceModels.json.

firmwares.name: esp32-rev1-lite
firmwares.description: ESP32 classic revision 0 and 1 with PSRAM (the older WROVER modules): WiFi + Ethernet, the PSRAM cache workaround, PSRAM used, the 4 MB tier (no SD card).

firmwares.name: esp32s3-qspi
firmwares.description: ESP32-S3 with quad PSRAM and more than 4 MB flash (N8R2, such as the Adafruit MatrixPortal S3): WiFi + W5500 SPI Ethernet, every feature.

firmwares.name: esp32s3-qspi-lite
firmwares.description: ESP32-S3 with quad PSRAM and 4 MB flash (N4R2, such as the ESP32-S3-Zero): WiFi, the 4 MB tier.

firmwares.name: esp32s3-opi
firmwares.description: ESP32-S3 with octal PSRAM, 8 MB flash and up (N8R8, N16R8): WiFi + W5500 SPI Ethernet, every feature.

firmwares.name: esp32s3-opi-oflash
firmwares.description: ESP32-S3 with octal PSRAM and octal flash (WROOM-2 N32R16V): WiFi + W5500 SPI Ethernet, every feature.

firmwares.name: esp32c3
firmwares.description: ESP32-C3 (4 MB flash, no PSRAM) - WiFi only, one RISC-V core at 160 MHz.

firmwares.name: esp32p4rev1
firmwares.description: ESP32-P4 revisions 0.x and 1.x: Ethernet, and WiFi over the on-board ESP32-C6 where the board has one.

firmwares.name: esp32p4rev3
firmwares.description: ESP32-P4 revisions 3.x, the current silicon: Ethernet, and WiFi over the on-board ESP32-C6 where the board has one. Differs from esp32p4rev1 only in the chip revision; no revision 3 board is on the bench.

firmwares.name: esp32s31
firmwares.description: Espressif ESP32-S31 Function-CoreBoard-1: WiFi 6 + 1 Gbps Ethernet LED control (RISC-V, 16 MB flash, PSRAM). The on-chip EMAC drives the board's YT8531 RGMII PHY; Ethernet is preferred when a cable is present, WiFi otherwise. esp32s31 is a preview target on the v6.1 IDF line.

firmwares.name: teensy41
firmwares.description: Teensy 4.1: its own Ethernet PHY, or on the 4.1-NE a W5500 module on its SPI port, found at boot.
